channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: EPF welcomes proposed basic medical insurance withdrawals
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Employees Provident Fund (EPF) sees the plan to allow withdrawals for basic medical insurance or takaful (MHIT) as a positive step.

item.title: MyCreative opens 2026 Matching Fund Scheme with grants up to RM250,000
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The 2026 Matching Fund Scheme (SDP) is now open for applications until May 27 this year, offering grants of up to RM250,000 per approved application to support the production of works in the country’s creative industry sector.

item.title: Malaysia Airlines flights to Doha, Jeddah return to KLIA over airspace risk
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia Airlines confirmed that two flights, MH160 to Doha and MH156 to Jeddah, returned to Kuala Lumpur yesterday following a conflict-area risk advisory.

item.title: Roadside diesel transfer syndicate busted in Simpang Ampat
item.description: BATU KAWAN: A syndicate’s tactic of using a dead-end road near a residential area for illegal roadside diesel transfers was foiled by the Penang Domestic Trade and Cost of Living Ministry this morning.

item.title: EPF expects moderate growth for 2026
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Employees Provident Fund (EPF) expects a moderate outlook for 2026, with steady economic growth globally and continued growth in Malaysia.

item.title: GOF personnel required to wear bulletproof vests along Kelantan border
item.description: KOTA BARU: All personnel from the General Operations Force (GOF) deployed along the Malaysia–Thailand border in Kelantan are required to wear bulletproof vests while on duty as a safety precaution.

item.title: Two more arrested in Bukit Kayu Hitam shooting
item.description: BUKIT KAYU HITAM: Another two local men have been arrested in connection with the shooting of the Malaysian Border Control and Protection Agency (MCBA) commander in Bukit Kayu Hitam on Wednesday.

item.title: EPF contributors pragmatic about lower EPF dividend for 2025
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The lower Employees Provident Fund’s (EPF) 6.15 per cent dividend for 2025, compared to last year’s 6.30 per cent payout, drew measured reactions from contributors.

item.title: State of emergency declared as Israel hits Iran in 'preventive strike'
item.description: JERUSALEM: Israel’s defence ministry announced Saturday it had launched a “preemptive strike” on Iran as sirens sounded in Jerusalem and people across the country received phone alerts about an “extremely serious” threat.
